notes.title: New Dev Blog, who dis?
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Guardians![/p][p]
We’ve been hard at work developing Roboquest VR, but we figured you [i]might[/i] want to hear some updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433908/1d4cd7b1737457f8c69dec257f8c85d4a0218363.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So here it is: our first of many weekly dev blogs! Roboquest VR is coming to you this year, and in the meantime, we’ll be giving you all the updates you’ve been asking for. You can also join our Discord or follow us on socials for more news and sneak peeks![/p][p]
[/p][p]You might’ve noticed - or you will now that we’ve said it - that the store page doesn’t show multiplayer support anymore. [b]Don’t fear! Multiplayer is still coming to Roboquest VR![/b] We had to make a brief store change for QA purposes. We’ll have more news on multiplayer in the future, but we wanted to reassure any of you eagle-eyed guardians that it’s still on its way.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks for all your support and many, many messages asking about Roboquest VR. We are SO excited to share it with you![/p][p]
[/p][p]See you soon,[/p][p]Flat2VR Studios[/p][p]
[/p][p]PS - Drop in the discussion or Discord what topics you want to see updates on next…weapons? VR specialties? Something else?[/p][p]
[/p]
